cv.name: Kara Donovan
cv.headline: Marketing Manager | Financial Services & Property
cv.summary: Marketer with eight years across events, property and a member-owned bank in Brisbane. I run brand and acquisition campaigns end to end and have spent the last year acting up into the manager role while the position was restructured.

experience.title: Mktg Mgr – Growth & Brand (Band 5)
bullets: Run acquisition campaigns for home loans and transaction accounts across search, social and radio
Grew online home loan applications by 35% while cost per application fell
Manage the brand refresh with an external agency and roll out new guidelines to 18 branches
Sign off marketing copy against ASIC RG 234 and internal compliance checks

experience.title: Marketing & Comms Specialist / Acting Mgr
bullets: Managed launch campaigns for three apartment projects, including display suite events
Acted as marketing manager for 7 months during parental leave cover

experience.title: Mktg Coord.
bullets: Coordinated ticketing campaigns and sponsor deliverables for festivals and corporate events
